Free from gluten, dairy, eggs, soy, peanuts & tree nuts. Makes 1 dozen 4" cookies, 6 large cookies, or 9" cookie cake.

Save Recipe
Ingredients
Dry
1 cup + 2 TBSP oat flour
1/2 cup + 2 TBSP brown rice flour
1/2 cup + 2 TBSP tapioca starch
1/2 cup cane sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup chocolate chips
2 TBSP ground golden flaxseeds
1 teaspoon baking powder
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon sea salt
1 teaspoon xanthan gum
1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
Wet
1/2 cup avocado oil
1/4 cup water
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Steps
1

Preheat oven to 350°F. Line baking sheet with parchment or silicone mat. Combine dry ingredients into a large mixing bowl and whisk well. In a separate small bowl, whisk together oil, water, and vanilla.

2

Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix well with a firm spatula until a thick dough forms. Using a cookie scoop, roll dough into 2"balls and place onto sheet equally spaced apart. Divide dough into 6 equal portions for large gourmet cookies, or press dough into a greased 9" cake pan.

3

Bake 4” cookies for 12-15 minutes, large cookies for 20-25 minutes, or cookie cake for 25-30 minutes. Let cool on rack for 15 minutes or until firm. Enjoy!

Tips

Recipe Notes: Melted butter or vegan butter can be used in place of oil but the cookies aren't as chewy. Recipe has not been tested with any premade gluten free flour blends yet!

  2. Whisk dry ingredients in a large bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk oil, water, and vanilla.
  3. Combine wet and dry ingredients until a thick dough forms. Roll into 2-inch balls with a cookie scoop.
  4. Bake standard 4" cookies for 12–15 minutes (or 20–25 minutes for large cookies). Cool on a wire rack for 15 minutes.

### 2. Gluten-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
- **Author:** RJ Penn (@rjpenn)
- **URL:** https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/11003939
- **Notes:** Traditional soft and chewy style using a 1-to-1 all-purpose gluten-free blend; completely nut-free.
- **Ingredients:**
  - 1/2 cup shortening (e.g. Crisco)
  - 1/2 cup butter or vegan buttery spread
  - 1/8 tsp butter flavor (optional)
  - 2 large eggs
  - 3/4 cup granulated sugar
  - 3/4 cup dark brown sugar
  - 2 1/3 cups all-purpose gluten-free flour (such as Bob's Red Mill 1-to-1)
  - 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt
  - 1 tsp baking powder (aluminum-free)
  - 8 oz semi-sweet chocolate chips
- **Overview / Steps:**

  2. Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt together in a separate bowl.
  3. Mix in vanilla extract, then fold in flour mixture gradually on low speed.
  4. Fold in chocolate chips using a spatula.
  5. Chill dough in refrigerator for 45–60 minutes.
  6. Preheat oven to 365–375°F. Scoop 1-inch balls 2 inches apart on a lined sheet.

Free from gluten, dairy, eggs, soy, peanuts & tree nuts. Makes 1 dozen 4" cookies, 6 large cookies, or 9" cookie cake.

Save Recipe
Ingredients
Dry
1 cup + 2 TBSP oat flour
1/2 cup + 2 TBSP brown rice flour
1/2 cup + 2 TBSP tapioca starch
1/2 cup cane sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup chocolate chips

1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon sea salt
1 teaspoon xanthan gum
1/2 teaspoon cream of tartar
Wet
1/2 cup avocado oil
1/4 cup water
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
Steps
1

Preheat oven to 350°F. Line baking sheet with parchment or silicone mat. Combine dry ingredients into a large mixing bowl and whisk well. In a separate small bowl, whisk together oil, water, and vanilla.

2

Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and mix well with a firm spatula until a thick dough forms. Using a cookie scoop, roll dough into 2"balls and place onto sheet equally spaced apart. Divide dough into 6 equal portions for large gourmet cookies, or press dough into a greased 9" cake pan.

3

Bake 4” cookies for 12-15 minutes, large cookies for 20-25 minutes, or cookie cake for 25-30 minutes. Let cool on rack for 15 minutes or until firm. Enjoy!

Tips

Recipe Notes: Melted butter or vegan butter can be used in place of oil but the cookies aren't as chewy. Recipe has not been tested with any premade gluten free flour blends yet!

Usually if I have any over ripened bananas I make a banana loaf but I thought I'd try and do banana cookies and see how they'd come out. Big hit! They make a lovely, cakey cookie! Handy portions and you don't need a knife to slice a cake!

Ingredients
36 servings
170 grams (3/4 cup) softened butter / sunflower spread
120 grams (1/2 cup) packed) light brown sugar
100 grams granulated sugar
60 ml coconut milk
1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1 medium banana and 1 small banana, well mashed
140 grams (1 cup) plain / gluten-free flour
80 grams (1 cup) rolled oats

Steps
1

Preheat the oven to gas 4 / 180C / 375°F and line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper

2

Cream the butter and sugars until light and fluffy

3

Add in the milk, vanilla and mashed banana. It'll look curdled but don't worry. Mix well

4

Here are recipes for gluten-free chocolate chip cookies made without nuts found directly on Cookpad:

### 1. Gluten Free & Vegan Chocolate Chip Cookies
- **Author:** Whitney | Sprinkle&Spice (@SprinkleandSpice)
- **URL:** https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/25497039
- **Notes:** Explicitly free from gluten, dairy, eggs, soy, peanuts, and tree nuts. Yields 12 standard cookies or 6 large cookies.
- **Ingredients:**
  - Dry:
    - 1 cup + 2 tbsp oat flour
    - 1/2 cup + 2 tbsp brown rice flour
    - 1/2 cup + 2 tbsp tapioca starch
    - 1/2 cup cane sugar
    - 1/2 cup brown sugar
    - 1/2 cup chocolate chips
    - 2 tbsp ground golden flaxseeds
    - 1 tsp baking powder
    - 1 tsp baking soda
    - 1 tsp sea salt
    - 1 tsp xanthan gum
    - 1/2 tsp cream of tartar
  - Wet:
    - 1/2 cup avocado oil (or melted vegan butter)
    - 1/4 cup water
    - 1 tsp vanilla extract
- **Overview / Steps:**
  1. Preheat oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. Whisk dry ingredients in a large bowl. In a separate bowl, whisk oil, water, and vanilla.
  3. Combine wet and dry ingredients until a thick dough forms. Roll into 2-inch balls with a cookie scoop.
  4. Bake standard 4" cookies for 12–15 minutes (or 20–25 minutes for large cookies). Cool on a wire rack for 15 minutes.

---

### 2. Gluten-Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
- **Author:** RJ Penn (@rjpenn)
- **URL:** https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/11003939
- **Notes:** Traditional soft and chewy style using a 1-to-1 all-purpose gluten-free blend; completely nut-free.
- **Ingredients:**
  - 1/2 cup shortening (e.g. Crisco)
  - 1/2 cup butter or vegan buttery spread
  - 1/8 tsp butter flavor (optional)
  - 2 large eggs
  - 3/4 cup granulated sugar
  - 3/4 cup dark brown sugar
  - 2 1/3 cups all-purpose gluten-free flour (such as Bob's Red Mill 1-to-1)
  - 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt
  - 1 tsp baking powder (aluminum-free)
  - 8 oz semi-sweet chocolate chips
- **Overview / Steps:**
  1. In a stand mixer, cream shortening, butter, optional butter flavor, eggs, and sugars on medium-high for about 2 minutes until light and creamy.
  2. Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt together in a separate bowl.
  3. Mix in vanilla extract, then fold in flour mixture gradually on low speed.
  4. Fold in chocolate chips using a spatula.
  5. Chill dough in refrigerator for 45–60 minutes.
  6. Preheat oven to 365–375°F. Scoop 1-inch balls 2 inches apart on a lined sheet.
  7. Bake for 11–12 minutes until edges lightly brown. Cool on a wire rack.

---

### 3. Gluten Free Chocolate Chip Cookies
- **Author:** Jim Kennedy (@jimkmaus)
- **URL:** https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/5334073
- **Notes:** Made with a gluten-free flour blend, rice flour, and oat bran; no nuts used.
- **Ingredients:**
  - 1 cup butter
  - 1 cup brown sugar (firmly packed)
  - 1/2 cup granulated sugar
  - 2 tsp vanilla extract
  - 1 tsp kosher salt
  - 2 large eggs
  - 1 2/3 cups gluten-free flour blend
  - 1/2 cup rice flour
  - 1/4 cup oat bran
  - 1 tsp baking powder
  - 1 tsp baking soda
  - 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips
- **Overview / Steps:**
  1. Beat butter, sugars, vanilla, and salt until smooth.
  2. Beat in eggs one at a time.
  3. Combine dry ingredients (flours, oat bran, baking powder, baking soda) and mix into butter mixture on low speed.
  4. Fold in chocolate chips and chill covered dough in refrigerator for 1 hour.
  5. Scoop onto parchment-lined baking sheets and bake at 350°F for 10 minutes (rotating halfway through).

---

### 4. Gluten Free Chocolate Chip Cookies (Quick Baking Mix Version)
- **Author:** shari.l.george (@cook_3827685)
- **URL:** https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/463677
- **Notes:** Simple 7-ingredient recipe utilizing King Arthur gluten-free baking mix; nut-free.
- **Ingredients:**
  - 1/2 cup softened butter
  - 1/2 cup packed brown sugar
  - 2 tsp vanilla
  - 1 egg
  - 2 3/4 cups King Arthur gluten-free baking mix
  - 1/3 cup milk
  - 1 cup chocolate chips
- **Overview / Steps:**
  1. Mix softened butter, brown sugar, vanilla, and egg in a bowl.
  2. Stir in the gluten-free baking mix.
  3. Stir in milk and chocolate chips.
  4. Drop by rounded tablespoons onto a greased sheet and flatten slightly.
  5. Bake at 375°F for approximately 12 minutes; cool on a wire rack.

### 5. Gluten and Dairy-Free Banana Chocolate Chip Cookies
- **Author:** eXoTiK (@cook_3280520)
- **URL:** https://cookpad.com/eng/recipes/349259
- **Notes:** Oatmeal-banana base with no flour, nuts, eggs, or dairy.
- **Ingredients:**
  - 3 bananas (mashed)
  - 1/3 cup applesauce
  - 1/4 cup soy milk
  - 1 tsp vanilla extract
  - 1 tsp ground cinnamon
  - 2 cups gluten-free oats
  - 1/2 cup dairy-free chocolate chips
- **Overview / Steps:**
  1. Mash bananas and mix with applesauce, soy milk, vanilla, and cinnamon.
  2. Stir in certified gluten-free rolled oats and chocolate chips.
  3. Drop by spoonfuls onto a prepared cookie sheet and bake at 350°F for 15–20 minutes.
